translations.zh: 熙宗在位，宗翰、宗幹、宗弼相繼秉政，帝臨朝端默。
translations.literal: While Xizong held the throne, Zonghan, Zonggan, and Zongbi successively wielded government; the emperor sat in court dignified and silent.
translations.idiomatic: During Xizong's reign Zonghan, Zonggan, and Zongbi held power in succession, while the emperor presided at court in dignified silence.

translations.zh: 雖初年國家多事，而廟算制勝，齊國就慶，宋人請臣，吏清政簡，百姓樂業。
translations.literal: Although in the early years the state had many affairs, plans made in the temple secured victory; Qi was established and celebrated, the Song people requested to become subjects, officials were clean and government was simple, and the common people were content in their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Though the early years were turbulent, state strategy prevailed: Qi was established and celebrated, the Song submitted as subjects, officials were upright and government was lean, and the people prospered in their work.

translations.zh: 宗弼既沒，舊臣亦多物故，后干預政事，無所忌憚，朝官往往因之以取宰相。
translations.literal: After Zongbi died, many old ministers also passed away; the empress intervened in government affairs without restraint, and court officials often used her to obtain the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: After Zongbi's death many veteran ministers had also died; the empress intervened in government without restraint, and court officials often used her influence to win the chancellorship.

translations.zh: 濟安薨後，數年繼嗣不立，后頗掣制熙宗。
translations.literal: After Ji'an died, for several years no heir was established; the empress considerably restrained Xizong.
translations.idiomatic: After Crown Prince Ji'an died, no successor was named for years, and the empress increasingly constrained Xizong.

translations.zh: 熙宗內不能平，因無聊，縱酒酗怒，手刃殺人。
translations.literal: Xizong inwardly could not be at peace; out of boredom he gave himself to drink, drunken rage, and killing men with his own hand.
translations.idiomatic: Xizong could not reconcile himself inwardly; bored and restless, he drank heavily, flew into drunken rages, and killed men with his own blade.

translations.zh: 左丞相亮生日，上遣大興國以司馬光畫像、玉吐鶻、廄馬賜之，后亦附賜生日禮物。
translations.literal: On the birthday of Left Chancellor Liang, the emperor sent Da Xingguo to bestow on him a portrait of Sima Guang, a jade goshawk, and stable horses; the empress also added birthday gifts of her own.
translations.idiomatic: On Left Chancellor Liang's birthday the emperor sent Da Xingguo with a portrait of Sima Guang, a jade goshawk, and horses from the imperial stables as gifts; the empress added birthday presents of her own.

translations.zh: 熙宗聞之，怒，遂杖興國而奪回所賜。
translations.literal: When Xizong heard of it he was angry, had Xingguo beaten with the staff, and took back what had been given.
translations.idiomatic: When Xizong heard of this he was furious; he had Xingguo beaten and reclaimed the gifts.

translations.zh: 海陵本懷覬覦，因之疑畏愈甚，蕭牆之變，從此萌矣。
translations.literal: Hailing had long harbored ambition; because of this his suspicion and fear grew all the sharper, and the calamity within the palace walls began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing had long coveted the throne; this incident deepened his suspicion and fear, and the palace coup began to take shape from that moment.

translations.zh: 近侍高壽星隨例遷屯燕南，入訴於后，后激怒熙宗，殺左司郎中三合，杖平章政事秉德，而壽星竟得不遷。
translations.literal: The attendant Gao Shouxing was, according to precedent, to be transferred and settled in southern Yan; he came in to appeal to the empress, who enraged Xizong; Xizong killed Left Department Director Sanhe and beat Pingzhang Zhengshi Bingde with the staff, yet Shouxing in the end was not transferred.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant Gao Shouxing was slated for resettlement in southern Yan; he appealed to the empress, who provoked Xizong's anger. Xizong killed Left Department Director Sanhe and beat Chief Councillor Bingde, yet Shouxing was not transferred after all.

translations.zh: 秉德、唐括辯之奸謀起焉，海陵乘之，以成逆亂之計。
translations.literal: The treacherous plot of Bingde and Tangkuo Bian arose from this; Hailing seized the opportunity to complete his plan of rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: From this arose the treacherous plot of Bingde and Tangkuo Bian, which Hailing exploited to carry out his plan of usurpation.
